title: Momoi Airi — Shine On Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Morning
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How did I wake up an hour before my alarm was set to go off?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess I'm just that anxious after hearing yesterday about how we get to perform at Idol Lovers.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To be fair, it's natural for me to be this excited since I've been dreaming of performing on that stage forever.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Plus, leaving home early means having time to practice for a bit on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright. I gotta make the most of today!
MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, where should I begin today?
I'll just start with stretches, and then go over the choreography and...huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Spin and... Pose!
Hmm... No, that still doesn't seem right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! A-Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you doing here?!
You're way earlier than usual!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I could say the same thing!
Why are you here so early?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Uhh... So, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I became so excited about getting to perform at Idol Lovers that I started having trouble sitting still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I couldn't wait to start practicing for it, so I decided to come early.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I guess great minds think alike!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Airi, you too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! I mean, this is Idol Lovers we're talking about! We have every right to be excited!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, I was so excited that as soon as I got home, I immediately watched the Blu-ray of Idol Lovers from two years ago!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Two years ago...?
Great choice! That really was a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
In particular, VUz's performance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, the way they danced that day was so cool...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Their routines also involved interacting with the crowd more than usual...! They really set the place on fire!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
They did it just for that day! My jaw was on the floor the entire time...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And now, we get to perform on that stage...
It feels like a dream, but it's not.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you said that you've been dreaming of performing there since you were in QT, so I can't imagine how happy you are right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I kept believing that I'd for sure get a chance to perform on that stage someday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially when the other idols from my agency kept getting invited...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: From your agency?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That started happening around the time I began appearing solo on TV.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Phew... That lesson's finally over, so now I need to ask our manager about tomorrow's show and...)

rows.Speaker: Junior Idols
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, Airi!
How are you?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, how's it going?
What are you guys talking about? You seem really excited.

rows.Speaker: Junior Idols
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this...!
We just got invited to perform at Idol Lovers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Idol Lovers...?!

rows.Speaker: Junior Idols
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That's why we got a little loud just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
I mean, Idol Lovers?! That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're all always working so hard, staying late to practice too. Congratulations! I can't wait to see your performance!

rows.Speaker: Junior Idols
rows.Line: Thank you very much! We promise to do our best!

rows.Speaker: Junior Idols
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry, you'll need to excuse us...
We have to get to a meeting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Idol Lovers, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That really is incredible. They get to perform on that stage...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As things stand, QT doesn't have the name recognition to get an invite. I know that, but...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I wanna sing and dance on a stage like that someday.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I wanna perform at that giant sparkling venue and get my big break as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I know I will... Someday!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In the end, my wish never came true because QT never got invited.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the industry has taken notice of MORE MORE JUMP! So, I couldn't be happier about receiving this invite.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Obviously, it's not the finish line... But it's still my dream to perform on that stage. So, you bet I'm going to give it all I have!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's take all the joy we're feeling right now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And use it to put on a performance not only worthy of Idol Lovers, but our best one yet!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
